name: Namma Metro Phase 1
scope: 42.3 km, 40 stations across the East-West and North-South corridors
notes: The site's earliest-dated record, added deliberately per spec P9 (pre-2020 history is the main defence against the site being read as partisan). sanction_date is year-level precision only — "It was in 2006 that Phase I was sanctioned" (The News Minute, 2016-10-20) does not give a specific date. Other figures for this project circulate in search results — a ₹5,400 cr or ₹6,395 cr original sanction, and a ₹14,291.28 cr amount "spent by January 2017" — but this collection pass could not independently verify any of them against their original source text, so they are deliberately withheld rather than recorded on an unconfirmed basis. Only the ₹13,800 cr figure directly confirmed from The News Minute is recorded below; note it may itself already reflect cost escalation from the 2006 sanction rather than the original approved figure — the source does not make this distinction explicit.
